feeds.title: Knight Real Estate Group Blog
feeds.description: Knight Real Estate Group brings outstanding client advocacy, true professionalism, and unsurpassed knowledge of the field of real estate to all aspects of the buying and selling process in Santa Barbara, California. We truly listen to our client's needs and present them with opportunities, solutions, and the type of creative thinking that only a Realtor well-versed in real estate law can provide. Our ventures are documented in our blog.

feeds.title: Susan Pate Blog
feeds.description: Susan has been in the business of real estate since 1991. Her client list is extraordinary, her private and public property listings are always in demand, and her enthusiasm is unmatched. She posts articles in her blog about recent happenings in the real estate sector.

feeds.title: The Santa Barbara Group Blog
feeds.description: The Santa Barbara Group represents the region's finest properties with exceptional skill using the most innovative technologies currently available. Their years of full-time experience have given them a clear understanding of the mindset of home buyers and sellers and a thorough understanding of the regional marketplace. For news, tips, and information on the Santa Barbara CA real estate market, places to visit, and more, read their blog.

feeds.title: Santa Barbara Beach Blog
feeds.description: WELCOME TO THE SANTA BARBARA BEACH BLOG! maintained by Kathleen Winter. This blog provides current and comprehensive information regarding the Santa Barbara beach real estate market with the scoop on new listings, price reductions, and closings of all beachfront and oceanfront properties along the Santa Barbara coastline. Kathleen Winter has specialized in the marketing and sale of beach and estate properties in Santa Barbara for over 30 years. Enjoy viewing information regarding beach property.

feeds.title: Terry Ryken Blog
feeds.description: TEAM RYKEN is focused on professional excellence and prides itself in unparalleled levels of personal service along with cutting-edge technology to meet your real estate needs. they have years of combined Real Estate experience, which will help you find what you are looking for.

feeds.title: Jennifer Berger Homes Blog
feeds.description: With over 18 years of experience in the field of real estate, Jennifer has worked on hundreds of real estate transactions along the California coastline. Her experience is well diversified and varies across all priced points and types of real estate. Stay up to date with the latest news, updates, and articles on Jennifer's blog.

feeds.title: Paradise Retreats Blog
feeds.description: Paradise Retreats offers unsurpassed service to Guests and Owners of the vacation homes we represent. Our properties are beautiful and well-maintained and have all the amenities you would expect in a luxury home. We specialize in satisfying the needs of the discriminating customer, who expects the best in service and quality. Before visiting Santa Barbara for your vacation, be sure to check out our blog where you can find out the top things happening in town!

feeds.title: Divid Kim Group Blog
feeds.description: David Kim's group has been in the real estate business for years now, they use a client-first approach to real estate and always work with the client's best interest in mind. In his blog, he posts about their achievements, the condition of real estate, new listings, what is the future, and more.

feeds.title: Abel Ramos Blog
feeds.description: Abel Ramos is a Broker Associate with Compass in Santa Barbara. Over the last 15 years as a broker, Abel has sold over 600 homes, putting him in the top 1% for sales volume in the country. In addition to sales, Abel has renovated and rebuilt dozens of highly distressed homes from the ground up, owned and operated apartment complexes, and grown a successful real estate investment company.
